title: The Power of Leverage: Netflix's Secret Weapon

That is the effect by which businesses can become significantly more or less profitable with comparatively small changes in their revenue. In this video, I want to compare two companies, both in the media space, that have had very different business results over the past 10 years. One has grown its revenue more than seven times in the past decade, and as we'll get to in this video has had substantially greater increases in their profitability, and the other business has experienced about a 12 or 13% decline in their revenue, and again, as we'll get to in this video, a substantially greater decline in their operating income. Now firstly let's talk about the business models, of course Netflix is their world's largest and most successful streaming service, they have grown a lot in the past decade, and their business model for a long time and still to a significant extent is licensing content from other studios, both in the US and also outside of the United States as well. And operating leverage is a fantastic thing when a business is growing but it's a terrible thing when a business is shrinking and Netflix and Sky TV again are pretty good examples of that.
